capabilities: Color TaskNotes task cards automatically by project name
Compute a deterministic hue from a DJB2 hash of the project name
Tint card backgrounds and left borders in both light and dark themes
Allow saturation and lightness overrides via a CSS snippet
disambiguation: Not a general task colorizer; it only colors cards rendered by the TaskNotes plugin and has no effect on other notes or plugins.
extras: The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. It works by watching the DOM, so colors depend on TaskNotes's current markup.
intentEvidence: The plugin watches the DOM for TaskNotes task cards. When a card contains a project link
problem: TaskNotes renders task cards looking alike regardless of project, making it hard to visually tell projects apart without manual per-project configuration.

relations.evidence: Automatically colors TaskNotes task cards by project.

summary: Color-coding plugin that gives TaskNotes task cards a distinct background color and left border derived from each project's name.
